source.label: FRED official downloads and source metadata
caveats: Latest revised values. Observation date is not publication date. No complete point-in-time history.
Units and seasonal adjustment vary by series. Missing values are retained.

evidenceFlow.title: Retrieve and verify
evidenceFlow.detail: updater/update_us_macro.py; GET each dictionary.download_url and dictionary.source_url. Exact requested dates and SHA256 are archived in data/raw. Validate metadata, dates, duplicates and numeric values.

evidenceFlow.title: Derive and export
evidenceFlow.detail: CPI/PCE YoY uses exact same calendar month last year; PAYEMS_CHANGE subtracts the previous calendar month. Export without interpolation using updater/export_data.py.
